name: Lagnam Spintex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Lagnam Spintex Ltd manufactures cotton yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
LSL is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company and manufactures 100% Cotton Ring  and Open - End Yarn to cater to Denims, Terry Towels, Home Textiles, Bottom Wear, Shirting, Sheeting and Knitting Segments, in the count range of Ne 4 - Ne 30.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.12 times its book value
Company's median sales growth is 16.3% of last 10 years
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.2% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 48.2% of their holding.
Dividend payout has been low at 4.31% of profits over last 3 years
